maintenance_led.reason: Sells plasma collection devices with disposable sets, plus vascular closure and blood management products; mostly consumables and new device sales, not repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Main customers are commercial plasma collectors (e.g., CSL, Grifols) and hospitals; payers are private businesses, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own plasma, hospital and interventional product lines; acquisitions like Cardiva and OpSens were occasional.

mission_critical.reason: FDA-cleared NexSys PCS plasma systems are embedded in collectors' validated workflows; switching needs requalification and regulatory approval.

notes: Revenue is mostly consumables tied to installed devices; the larger Apheresis plasma business was judged as consumables, not maintenance.
